hooks.command: f=$(node -e "const d=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(0,'utf8'));process.stdout.write(d.tool_input?.file_path||d.tool_response?.filePath||'')"); case "$f" in *.vue|*.ts|*.js|*.mjs) out=$( { NO_COLOR=1 node_modules/.bin/prettier --write "$f" && NO_COLOR=1 node_modules/.bin/eslint --fix "$f"; } 2>&1 >/dev/null );; *.json|*.css) out=$( { NO_COLOR=1 node_modules/.bin/prettier --write "$f"; } 2>&1 >/dev/null );; esac; if [ -n "$out" ]; then node -e "process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({decision:'block',reason:'format/lint 失败:\n'+process.argv[1]}))" "$out"; fi

f=$(node -e "const d=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(0,'utf8'));process.stdout.write(d.tool_input?.file_path||d.tool_response?.filePath||'')"); case "$f" in *.ts|*.vue) out=$(node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit 2>/dev/null);; esac; if [ -n "$out" ]; then node -e "process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({decision:'block',reason:'typecheck 失败 (tsc --noEmit):\n'+process.argv[1]}))" "$out"; fi
